item.title: PHP2Shell: emergency PHP patches for two critical unauthenticated RCE flaws (CVE-2026-109618/-109619) as exploitation attempts begin
item.description:
Breaking: PHP released emergency fixes on Wednesday, Oct 21, 2026, around 7 AM PT for PHP2Shell, two critical (CVSS 9.2) flaws in the PHP runtime itself, CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619. They allow unauthenticated remote code execution and worker-memory reads on nearly every PHP version back to 5.4, across mod_php, PHP-FPM, php-cgi, FrankenPHP and LiteSpeed, regardless of the application on top.

Cloudflare and watchTowr report in-the-wild exploitation attempts already underway (watchTowr says none successful yet), governments in the US, EU, UK and elsewhere issued urgent warnings, and organizations including Nintendo took sites offline. Kevin Beaumont called it one of the biggest vulns in years.

Patch now to PHP 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36 or 8.2.35 (or your distro's backported package), then restart Apache, PHP-FPM and long-running workers. Isolate anything that can't be patched.

Sources: The Record, The Hacker News, Help Net Security, BleepingComputer

item.title: Citrix confirms actively exploited NetScaler RCE zero-days (CVE-2026-88771 / CVE-2026-88772)
item.description:
Breaking: Citrix confirmed two critical NetScaler ADC/Gateway remote code execution flaws were exploited as zero-days and released patches Sunday, Sep 27, 2026 (PT).

  • CVE-2026-88771 (CVSS 9.5): unauthenticated command execution via improper input validation. All NetScaler ADC and Gateway deployments are affected, including default configuration — no extra features required.
  • CVE-2026-88772 (CVSS 9.5): memory overflow leading to RCE or DoS when DTLS is enabled (DTLS is on by default for VPN virtual servers).

Vendor: "Exploits of CVE-2026-88771 and CVE-2026-88772 on unmitigated NetScaler deployments have been observed." Dutch NCSC and partners privately warned orgs over the weekend to take appliances offline ahead of disclosure. August builds that fixed CVE-2026-19490 remain vulnerable.

Patch now: 14.1-73.37 / 13.1-64.23 (and matching FIPS/NDcPP builds). Updating does not remove an already-present attacker — check Citrix IoCs / forensics.

Sources: Citrix CTX697096 · BleepingComputer
